scope: Narrow source successor review and local controls. Supplied private aggregate cgroup evidence was compared without host calls; no production timing qualification.
verified: Only the explicit fixed units in three known systemd cgroup families are accepted; literal escaped slice names are preserved and unknown units/paths refuse.
Initial source, temporary source, new proxy and retained proxy cgroups must equal their actual authenticated actor acknowledgements.

Every captured PID retains same-UID privilege/environment/argv/start-time checks and additionally reports its current kernel cgroup. All PID memberships must match the fixed unit ControlGroup; duplicate PID observations refuse.
Existing repeated source snapshots, final CAS, native readiness, financial, READ, private-file and retirement checks remain unchanged. Earlier immutable producers are not edited.
